issues.description: Fixed an issue in an active/active HA configuration where the V-wire interface on the active primary firewall forwarded the ICMP error code packet that was received by the active secondary firewall.
Fixed an out-of-memory condition that occurred due to multiple parallel jobs being created by the scheduled log export feature.
Fixed an issue where NetFlow traffic triggered a packet buffer leak.
Fixed an issue when calculating the incremental checksum after a post-NAT translation where the arguments to pan_in_cksm32_diff overflowed the 32-bit integer.
Fixed an issue where generating subordinate ECDSA Certificate Authority (CA) certificates from the web interface failed if the Common Name field contained a space.
